faq.a: Four: CTC→In-Hand (full breakdown), Reverse (find the CTC needed for a target monthly in-hand), Appraisal/Hike (apply a hike percentage and see the in-hand increase), and Compare Offers (two CTCs side by side with the higher-in-hand winner). You can input annual CTC or gross monthly, and all component assumptions are editable.

faq.q: Which deductions and assumptions can I adjust?
faq.a: Basic % of CTC, HRA % of basic, employee PF %, a gratuity %, LTA, and professional tax by state (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat and others). PF defaults to 12% of basic capped at the ₹15,000/month wage ceiling (₹1,800/month), with an option to compute on full basic. You can toggle ESI, add other deductions, and override the annual tax figure manually.

Under either the New Regime (2026 slabs: 0–4L nil, 4–8L 5%, up to 24L+ at 30%, with a ₹75,000 standard deduction and 87A rebate/marginal relief near ₹12L taxable) or the Old Regime (with ₹50,000 standard deduction and a ₹1.5L 80C assumption). A 4% cess is added. These are built-in estimates, not live tax-filing figures.

No — they're estimates for planning, not financial or tax advice, and the tool says so. Actual in-hand depends on your company's structure and policies, so confirm with HR. It shows a full monthly/annual component breakdown (and amounts in words), an earnings-vs-deductions bar, keeps saved calculations for comparison, and lets you copy a summary or print. Everything runs in your browser.
